scope: Native JP four-pillar geometry observation and bounded input-only approach study; no reached spinning high-crawl entry

sampler.scope: 153 barycentric points per upper triangle per transition; algebraic yaw formula with native trig values, not native platform-call replay

fourPillar.scope: Four pillars already credited in every search seed; original western box can provide approach height, with no requirement to preserve it

limits: Geometric polygon clipping uses double arithmetic on native planes.
The yaw sampler is a source-derived calculation, not execution of the native platform function with Mario at each sampled point.
The four-pillar search never reaches a crawling state or comes within 3909 units of the pyramid center while the top spins.
The preliminary 360-policy study used three-pillar near-top approaches and is excluded from moving-top evidence.
No original-ROM rerun or new Coq proof.
